title: 2019 YABANCI DİL BİLGİSİ SEVİYE TESPİT SINAVI - 3 (2019-YDS/3) İNGİLİZCE

questions.questionText: 1. Within our solar system, the planet Mars almost certainly had a surface ocean in the past and may still have ---- of it underground.
questions.explanation: Mars'ın geçmişte yüzeyinde bir okyanus olduğu ve yeraltında hala bunun 'kalıntılarının' (remnants) bulunabileceği ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) remnants
B) attractions
C) adjustments
D) precautions
E) illustrations

questions.questionText: 2. The fact is that, right now, the Sumatran tiger faces a number of very serious threats, which are putting their very survival in ----.
questions.explanation: Sumatra kaplanının hayatta kalmasının 'tehlikeye/riske' (jeopardy) girdiği belirtilmektedir. 'Put in jeopardy' kalıbı tehlikeye atmak demektir.
options: A) extension
B) resistence
C) jeopardy
D) distinction
E) corruption

questions.questionText: 3. The ---- importance of numbers in Chinese design stems from the influence of the harmonic principles of ying and yang, repeatedly seen in architectural designs.
questions.explanation: Çin tasarımında sayıların 'yaygın/derin' (pervasive) öneminin, ying ve yang'in harmonik ilkelerinden kaynaklandığı vurgulanmaktadır.
options: A) pervasive
B) distinctive
C) insignificant
D) disruptive
E) deceptive

questions.questionText: 4. The most sophisticated of Cook Islands handicrafts are considered to be tivaevae: brightly coloured, ---- embroidered ceremonial cloths, which require a great number of months to make.
questions.explanation: Törensel kumaşların parlak renkli ve 'karmaşık / ince bir şekilde' (intricately) işlendiği (embroidered) ifade ediliyor.
options: A) tediously
B) intricately
C) persistently
D) incidentally
E) objectively

questions.questionText: 5. Starting in 1640, Evliya Çelebi began a career of travel into the far reaches of the Ottoman Empire, which at that time ---- from Hungary in the north to Egypt and Sudan in the south.
questions.explanation: Osmanlı İmparatorluğu'nun o dönemde kuzeyde Macaristan'dan güneyde Mısır ve Sudan'a kadar 'uzandığı' (stretched) belirtilmektedir.
options: A) wandered
B) escalated
C) stretched
D) emigrated
E) circulated

questions.questionText: 6. Assimilation is a voluntary or involuntary process by which individuals or groups completely ---- the traits of another culture, leaving their original cultural and linguistic identities behind.
questions.explanation: Asimilasyon, bireylerin veya grupların başka bir kültürün özelliklerini tamamen 'üstlenmesi / benimsemesi' (take on) sürecidir.
options: A) break into
B) put away
C) make out
D) take on
E) bring about

questions.questionText: 7. Summer ice ---- a series of record low levels in recent years as the Arctic ---- twice as fast as the mid-latitudes.
questions.explanation: 'In recent years' (son yıllarda) ifadesi Present Perfect Tense gerektirir. Kuzey Kutbu'nun orta enlemlere göre iki kat daha hızlı 'ısınmakta olduğu' (has been warming) süreci anlatır.
options: A) hit / was warming
B) has hit / has been warming
C) hits / had been warming
D) will hit / warms
E) had hit / had warmed

questions.questionText: 8. Burials ---- an important role in the beliefs of the Lycians, for they cut hundreds of tombs into the cliff faces and crags that ---- throughout the area.
questions.explanation: Gömülmelerin Likyalıların inançlarında önemli bir rol 'oynamış olması gerektiği' (must have held) geçmişe yönelik güçlü bir çıkarımdır. Uçurumlarda 'görülebilen' (can be seen) yüzlerce mezar inşa etmişlerdir.
options: A) should have held / will be seen
B) were able to hold / should be seen
C) had to hold / might be seen
D) used to hold / have to be seen
E) must have held / can be seen

questions.questionText: 9. One of the greatest breakthroughs of the 17th century was to understand how and why things move and stop ----, and the key to the problem was that they slow down and stop only when something forces them ----.
questions.explanation: Nesnelerin nasıl hareket ettiğini ve hareket etmeyi nasıl bıraktıklarını (stop moving) anlamak ve nesnelerin sadece bir şey onları 'bunu yapmaya zorladığında' (forces them to do) durdukları ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) to be moved / having done
B) being moved / do
C) moving / to do
D) having moved / to have done
E) to move / doing

questions.questionText: 10. The Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) is intended to overcome the barriers to communication ---- professionals working in the field of modern languages arising ---- the different educational systems in Europe.
questions.explanation: Profesyoneller 'arasındaki' (among) iletişim engellerini ve farklı eğitim sistemlerin'den' (from) kaynaklanan (arising from) sorunları aşmak kastedilmektedir.
options: A) between / at
B) through / into
C) with / in
D) among / from
E) about / against

questions.questionText: 11. People in some countries are brainwashed ---- an early age to love junk food and fast food ---- advertising on television and many other mechanisms.
questions.explanation: Erken bir yaş'tan' (from an early age) itibaren televizyondaki reklamlar 'aracılığıyla / vasıtasıyla' (through) beyinlerinin yıkandığı belirtiliyor.
options: A) by / about
B) from / through
C) in / to
D) on / for
E) with / over

questions.questionText: 12. Among the drawbacks of aging is a creeping tendency to put on weight, ---- our resting metabolism slows down - by roughly 1 to 2 percent every decade.
questions.explanation: Yaşlanmanın dezavantajları arasında kilo alma eğilimi vardır, 'çünkü / olduğu için' (since) dinlenme metabolizmamız yavaşlar. (Sebep-sonuç ilişkisi).
options: A) but
B) since
C) as if
D) if only
E) even if

questions.questionText: 13. Feminism made an important difference to British culture throughout the 20th century ---- the struggle to change unequal gender relations took place in a range of contexts.
questions.explanation: Eşitsiz cinsiyet ilişkilerini değiştirme mücadelesi çeşitli bağlamlarda gerçekleştiği 'için / dıkça' (as), feminizm İngiliz kültüründe önemli bir fark yaratmıştır.
options: A) provided that
B) unless
C) as
D) in case
E) even though

questions.questionText: 14. Surpassed by tennis in the 19th century, croquet is today more of a recreational activity than competitive sport ---- intense competition has not disappeared entirely in croquet clubs.
questions.explanation: Günümüzde kroket rekabetçi bir spordan ziyade eğlence aktivitesi olmasına 'rağmen' (even though), kroket kulüplerinde yoğun rekabet tamamen ortadan kalkmamıştır (Zıtlık ilişkisi).
options: A) just as
B) even though
C) provided that
D) so that
E) as long as

questions.questionText: 15. The management of farms in the future will be influenced ---- by climate ---- by global demand and agricultural practices, so the winners will be farmers who modernise their methods and diversify their fields.
questions.explanation: Gelecekte çiftliklerin yönetimi, küresel talep ve tarımsal uygulamalardan etkilendiği 'kadar' (as much ... as) iklimden de etkilenecektir.
options: A) neither / nor
B) whether / or
C) as much / as
D) the more / the more
E) such / that

questions.questionText: 16. ---- connecting distant empires into an integrated web of commerce, the Silk Road carried infectious diseases that severely affected immunity-free populations.
questions.explanation: İpek Yolu'nun uzak imparatorlukları entegre bir ticaret ağına bağlamasının 'yanı sıra / dışında' (Apart from), bağışıklığı olmayan nüfusları ciddi şekilde etkileyen bulaşıcı hastalıkları da taşıdığı belirtilmektedir.
options: A) In case of
B) Apart from
C) In terms of
D) On behalf of
E) For the purpose of

questions.questionText: 17. Old blood may damage organs and contribute to ageing. Researchers are trying to reveal the restorative powers of young blood, (17)---- brains from ageing.
questions.explanation: Araştırmacıların genç kanın onarıcı güçlerini ortaya çıkarmaya çalıştığı ve bunu yaparken beyni yaşlanmaktan 'koruyarak / önleyerek' (preventing) etki ettikleri anlatılıyor (participle clause).
options: A) to be prevented
B) prevent
C) to have prevented
D) preventing
E) having prevented

questions.questionText: 18. In fact, the effects of blood on ageing were first discovered in experiments that stitched young and old mice together so that they shared circulating blood. Older mice seemed to (18)---- such an arrangement, developing healthier organs and becoming protected from age related disease.
questions.explanation: Yaşlı farelerin bu düzenlemeden daha sağlıklı organlar geliştirerek 'faydalandığı / yarar sağladığı' (benefit from) görülmüştür.
options: A) dispense with
B) relate to
C) compensate for
D) put off
E) benefit from

questions.questionText: 19. But younger mice aged prematurely. Such experiments suggest that (19)---- young blood can be restorative, there is something in old blood that is actively harmful.
questions.explanation: Genç kan onarıcı 'olabilirken / olmasına rağmen' (while), yaşlı kanda aktif olarak zararlı olan bir şey vardır (Zıtlık).
options: A) while
B) until
C) when
D) as soon as
E) after

questions.questionText: 20. Hanadie Yousef at Stanford University in California seems to have identified a protein that is causing some of the damage, and has developed a compound to block it. She has observed that (20)---- this antibody, mice were protected from the harmful effects of the old blood.
questions.explanation: Farelerin, geliştirilen bu antikor 'sayesinde' (thanks to) yaşlı kanın zararlı etkilerinden korunduğu gözlemlenmiştir.
options: A) contrary to
B) compared to
C) similar to
D) regardless of
E) thanks to

questions.questionText: 21. However, we do not yet know what it is about young blood that keeps animals youthful. That has not stopped people (21)---- starting trials to see if blood transfusions can treat age-related diseases.
questions.explanation: İnsanları kan transfüzyonlarının yaşa bağlı hastalıkları tedavi edip edemeyeceğini görmek için denemelere başlamak'tan' alıkoymadı ('stop someone from doing something' kalıbı).
options: A) by
B) for
C) in
D) from
E) with

questions.questionText: 22. How do you evacuate passengers from a long tunnel through a mountain? The Gotthard Base Tunnel, a railway tunnel through the heart of the Alps in Switzerland, has an emergency evacuation plan. If a fire were to (22)---- 2,000 metres beneath the Alps, the flames would spread so rapidly that the tunnel would transform into a fiery hell.
questions.explanation: Alplerin 2.000 metre altında bir yangın 'çıkacak' (break out) olursa... anlamında 'break out' (patlak vermek, aniden çıkmak) phrasal fiili kullanılır.
options: A) fade away
B) break out
C) fall behind
D) go off
E) run out

questions.questionText: 23. The nearest exit might still be many kilometres away. The solution is that, (23)---- a fire, two emergency stations will allow trains to cross over from one tunnel to the other.
questions.explanation: Bir yangın 'durumunda' (in case of), iki acil durum istasyonu trenlerin bir tünelden diğerine geçmesine izin verecektir.
options: A) instead of
B) by means of
C) apart from
D) in case of
E) as well as

questions.questionText: 24. (24)----, there are escape routes to a connecting corridor every 325 metres.
questions.explanation: Tüneller arası geçiş istasyonlarının varlığına 'ek olarak' (In addition), her 325 metrede bir kaçış rotaları bulunmaktadır.
options: A) To sum up
B) In other words
C) On the contrary
D) However
E) In addition

questions.questionText: 25. Ventilation equipment will suck smoke out of the main tunnel and spread fresh air (25)---- corridors running alongside the tunnel.
questions.explanation: Havalandırma ekipmanının, tünel boyunca uzanan koridorlar 'aracılığıyla / içinden geçerek' (through) temiz havayı yayacağı ifade ediliyor.
options: A) through
B) with
C) against
D) during
E) about

questions.questionText: 26. Passengers will exit the train and escape using these corridors, to which the doors can be tightly sealed a slight overpressure will prevent smoke ingress. The doors are strong enough to stop fire, yet are simple to open even a child can do it. There they will have to wait until a rescue train (26)----.
questions.explanation: 'Until' bağlacından sonra gelecek eylem gelecekte gerçekleşecek olsa da, zaman uyumu kuralı gereği Simple Present Tense (arrives) kullanılır.
options: A) is arriving
B) arrived
C) arrives
D) will arrive
E) was arriving

questions.questionText: 27. While being physically attractive seems to be a basic requirement for Internet celebrities, ----.
questions.explanation: Fiziksel olarak çekici olmak internet ünlüleri için temel bir gereklilik gibi görünse de (While), 'taze fikirler üretemez ve başarılı projelere dahil olamazlarsa popülariteleri düşecektir' zıtlığı cümleyi mantıksal olarak tamamlar.
options: A) they closely monitor the trends in youth culture that place special emphasis on beauty
B) their popularity will decline if they cannot create fresh ideas and engage in successful projects
C) they are chased by investors hoping to expand their business by associating their products with famous people
D) they are often characterised as having the ideal beauty standards
E) they earn huge amounts of money thanks to their collaboration with famous brands

questions.questionText: 28. Although Egypt was subject to outside influences, ----.
questions.explanation: Mısır dış etkilere maruz kalmasına rağmen (Although), 'kültürünün temel özellikleri uzun tarihi boyunca homojen kalmıştır' diyerek zıtlık yaratılmıştır.
options: A) the Egyptians settled on the fertile strip of land created by the Nile in the North African desert
B) the role played by the pharaoh, that of a link between men and gods, decreased with the disintegration of power
C) the principal characteristics of its culture remained homogenous throughout the course of its long history
D) the pyramids were built to testify to the pronounced hierarchical character of the Egyptian society
E) Ramses III, who undertook extensive administrative reforms, was forced to defend against fierce attacks

questions.questionText: 29. Owing to the increasing numbers of individuals and families who could no longer afford to purchase housing, ----.
questions.explanation: Konut satın almaya gücü yetmeyen bireylerin ve ailelerin sayısının artması nedeniyle (Owing to), '1980'lerin başında ABD'de evsizlik çok görünür hale geldi' (Neden-sonuç uyumu).
options: A) the American nation's supply of low-cost rental housing was shrinking
B) an ample boom was observed in the investment of housing construction
C) after the mid-1970s, the poor became more numerous and they got poorer
D) homelessness became so visible in the early 1980s in the US
E) there was a lack of federal commitment to production of public housing

questions.questionText: 30. ---- unless it is integrated into a meaningful curricular and instructional framework.
questions.explanation: Anlamlı bir müfredat ve öğretim çerçevesine entegre edilmedikçe (unless), 'teknolojinin eğitim üzerinde çok az etkisi olduğuna inanılır' cümlesi anlamca eksiksiz bir bütün oluşturur.
options: A) Technology is regarded to have the potential to improve education
B) Technology should be viewed as one tool among many
C) The use of technology requires teachers to confront their beliefs about learning
D) It is believed that technology has little influence on education
E) Technology provides an excellent platform for learning environments

questions.questionText: 31. Even though the new methods of Samuel Christian Hahnemann- the creator and developer of the treatment called homeopathy- were initially met with ridicule, ----
questions.explanation: Homeopatinin yaratıcısı Samuel Christian Hahnemann'ın yeni yöntemleri başlarda alay konusu olmasına rağmen (Even though), 'ölümüne kadar geçen sürede yeni tedavisiyle elde ettiği büyük başarı sonucunda tüm dünyada kabul gördü'.
options: A) the system was based on the idea that substances producing symptoms of sickness in healthy people would have a curative effect
B) homeopathic remedies used in holistic treatments were often a fraction of the cost of conventional drugs
C) by the time of his death, they were accepted over the world as a result of the great success he had with his new cure
D) he was disturbed by the medical system of his time, believing that its cures were crude and some of its strong drugs did more harm than good to patients
E) with the formation of the American Medical Association, which restricted alternative practices, homeopathy declined for half a century

questions.questionText: 32. A 2003 study of car-crash victims found that those with more fat were less likely to suffer abdominal injuries, ----.
questions.explanation: Araba kazası kurbanları üzerine yapılan araştırma, daha fazla yağı olanların karın yaralanması geçirme ihtimalinin daha düşük olduğunu buldu (yağın koruyuculuğu), 'ama hava yastığı olarak yağ prensibi bazı insanların düşünmesi gerektiği kadar koruyucu olmayabilir' (zıtlık).
options: A) so you are more likely to experience some kind of trauma even months after the accident happened
B) and no matter what protective measures you may have taken before a possible accident, it may still happen in the end
C) since there is no correlation between total weight of passengers and the risk of getting injured
D) but the fat-as-airbag principle may not actually be so protective as some people might think it must
E) although one's body fat can, in fact act as some sort of shock absorber in collisions

questions.questionText: 33. People do not have a problem with obsessive compulsive disorder ----.
questions.explanation: İnsanlar takıntılı düşünce ve eylemleri ilişkilerine veya özgürlük duygularına ciddi şekilde zarar vermeye başlamadıkça (unless), obsesif kompulsif bozuklukla ilgili bir sorun yaşamazlar.
options: A) as compulsions are undesired actions that people find themselves forced into doing over and over to reduce anxiety
B) when the disorder causes considerable emotional discomfort and a high level of anxiety
C) while the approach for treating it is quite similar to the treatments for anxiety, fear, and intense anger
D) unless their repetitive thoughts and actions begin to seriously harm their relationships or their sense of freedom
E) because it could be very severe and require them to act in collaboration with a therapist

questions.questionText: 34. ----, Alsace's long history of political insecurity and the devastation caused by the two world wars have impoverished the region.
questions.explanation: Toprakları verimli olmasına ve demir/kömür madenleri uzun zamandır bir zenginlik kaynağı oluşturmasına RAĞMEN (Although), Alsace'nin siyasi güvensizlik tarihi ve dünya savaşlarının yarattığı yıkım bölgeyi yoksullaştırmıştır.
options: A) Even though its heavy industry is not fully competitive with their more highly developed counterparts in other countries
B) While the region became the focus of territorial dispute between France and Germany in the mid-to-late 1800s
C) Although its lands are fertile, and the region's iron and coal mines have long constituted a source of wealth
D) Unless the region's general population participated heavily in the resistance to Germany's invasion and conquests
E) As the new movements seek to gain greater control over economic and social development and to establish the preservation of Alsatian culture

questions.questionText: 35. Some Roman baths might have been functioning, at least partially, into the fifth century, ----.
questions.explanation: Bazı Roma hamamları en azından kısmen beşinci yüzyıla kadar faaliyet gösteriyor olabilirdi, 'oysa / halbuki (while) yedinci ve sekizinci yüzyıllardan sonra hamam inşasının büyük ölçüde yavaşladığına dair işaretler vardır.'
options: A) so that it was the inability of later ancient administrations to maintain the vast and complicated water systems
B) but after many repairs, the Thermae of Agrippa was still open as a luxury establishment in the fifth century
C) while after the seventh and eighth centuries, there are signs of bath building greatly slowing
D) because as the great baths themselves disappeared, their memory lingered on in the public minds as myths and legends
E) thus, many of these baths could be described as charity baths, because they served the clergy as well as the poor

questions.questionText: 36. Throughout the Tanzimat era, Ottoman statesmen believed that as long as the European powers respected their country's sovereignty, ----
questions.explanation: Tanzimat dönemi boyunca Osmanlı devlet adamları, Avrupalı güçler ülkelerinin egemenliğine saygı duyduğu sürece (as long as), 'Avrupalıların ülke ekonomisine daha fazla erişimine izin vermekte çok az tehlike olduğuna veya hiç olmadığına' inanıyorlardı.
options: A) Ottoman citizens could not tolerate much of the trouble caused by dysfunctional institutions
B) they prevented the acquisition of immovable properties within the borders of the state by the citizens of neighbouring countries
C) it would be unfeasible to ensure the welfare and happiness of Ottoman citizens who dispersed across three continents
D) there was little or no danger in allowing Europeans ever greater access to their country's economy
E) seeking or accepting aid from a foreign power would mean to people nothing more than exile in distant lands

questions.questionText: 37. Accurate measurements in scientific investigations gained more importance in the 17th century, when scientists became aware that only with reliable measurements could they support their theories.
questions.explanation: 17. yüzyıl (the 17th century) nitelenerek 'bilim insanlarının sadece güvenilir ölçümlerle teorilerini destekleyebileceklerinin farkına vardıkları' (...when scientists became aware that...) şeklinde D şıkkında doğru tercüme edilmiştir.
options: A) Bilim insanlarının 17. yüzyılda teorilerini sadece güvenilir ölçümlerle destekleyebileceklerinin farkına varmasıyla bilimsel araştırmalardaki doğru ölçümler daha fazla önem kazandı.
B) Bilimsel araştırmalardaki doğru ölçümler, 17. yüzyılda bilim insanları teorilerinin sadece güvenilir ölçümlerle desteklenebileceğinin farkına varınca daha önemli hâle geldi.
C) 17. yüzyılda bilim insanlarının sadece güvenilir ölçümler sayesinde teorilerini destekleyebileceklerinin farkına varması, bilimsel araştırmalardaki doğru ölçümlere daha fazla önem kazandırdı.
D) Bilimsel araştırmalardaki doğru ölçümler, bilim insanlarının sadece güvenilir ölçümlerle teorilerini destekleyebileceklerinin farkına vardıkları 17. yüzyılda daha fazla önem kazandı.
E) Bilimsel araştırmalardaki doğru ölçümler, 17. yüzyılda bilim insanları teorilerini sadece güvenilir ölçümlerle destekleyebileceklerinin farkına vardıkları için daha çok önem kazandı.

questions.questionText: 38. Recent studies have shown that chocolate can slow down the signs of skin ageing because cocoa extract is packed with antioxidants that neutralise free radical damage, which can harm collagen production.
questions.explanation: 'Son/Yeni yapılan araştırmalar... göstermektedir' (Recent studies have shown that), 'çünkü kakao özütü... antioksidanlarla doludur' (because cocoa extract is packed with antioxidants...) karşılığı B seçeneğindedir.
options: A) Kakao özütünün kolajen üretimine zarar veren serbest radikal hasarını ortadan kaldıran antioksidanlarla dolu olduğu ve bu nedenle çikolatanın cilt yaşlanmasının belirtilerini yavaşlattığı yeni yapılan çalışmalarla ortaya konmuştur.

B) Yeni yapılan araştırmalar, çikolatanın cilt yaşlanmasının belirtilerini yavaşlatabildiğini göstermektedir çünkü kakao özütü, kolajen üretimine zarar verebilen serbest radikal hasarını ortadan kaldıran antioksidanlarla doludur.

C) Çikolata, cilt yaşlanmasının belirtilerini yavaşlatabilmektedir çünkü son yapılan araştırmalar, kolajen üretimine zarar veren serbest radikal hasarını ortadan kaldıran kakao özütünün antioksidanlarla dolu olduğunu göstermektedir.

D) Son yapılan araştırmalar, kakao özütü kolajen üretimine zarar verebilen serbest radikal hasarını ortadan kaldıran antioksidanlarla dolu olduğu için cilt yaşlanmasının yavaşlatılabildiğini göstermektedir.

E) Çikolatanın cilt yaşlanmasını yavaşlatabildiğini gösteren son araştırmalar, kakao özütünün kolajen üretimine zarar veren serbest radikal hasarını ortadan kaldıran antioksidanlarla dolu olmasıyla kabul edildi.

questions.questionText: 39. Dolly, the first mammal cloned from the DNA of an adult animal, was regarded as a monumental scientific breakthrough when her birth was announced in early 1997.
questions.explanation: Özne: Dolly, the first mammal cloned from the DNA of an adult animal (Yetişkin bir hayvanın DNA'sından klonlanan ilk memeli olan Dolly). Yüklem: was regarded as a monumental scientific breakthrough (çok büyük bir bilimsel gelişme olarak kabul edildi). Zaman Zarfı: when her birth was announced in early 1997 (1997'nin başında doğumu duyurulduğunda).
options: A) Dolly, yetişkin bir hayvanın DNA'sından klonlanan ilk memeli olarak 1997'nin başında doğumu duyurulduğu zaman çok büyük bir bilimsel gelişme olarak kabul edildi.
B) Yetişkin bir hayvanın DNA'sından klonlanan ilk memeli olarak çok büyük bir bilimsel gelişme kabul edilen Dolly, 1997'nin başında duyuruldu.
C) 1997'nin başında doğumu duyurulduğunda çok büyük bir bilimsel gelişme olarak kabul edilen Dolly, yetişkin bir hayvanın DNA'sından klonlanan ilk memelidir.
D) Yetişkin bir hayvanın DNA'sından klontanan ilk memeli olan Dolly, 1997'nin başında doğumu duyurulduğunda çok büyük bir bilimsel gelişme olarak kabul edildi.
E) Dolly, yetişkin bir hayvanın DNA'sından klonlanan ilk memeli olmasının duyurulmasıyla çok büyük bir bilimsel gelişme olarak kabul edildi.

questions.questionText: 40. İnsanlar et kelimesini ilk kullandıklarında sadece içeceğin karşıtı olarak yiyeceği kastettiler, ve et kelimesi ancak 1300'lerde hayvan eti anlamına karşılık gelmeye başladı.
questions.explanation: Tükçe cümlede 'ilk kullandıklarında' (when people first used) ve 'ancak 1300'lerde hayvan eti anlamına karşılık gelmeye başladı' (it was not until the 1300s that it began to refer to...) kalıpları vardır, D şıkkı bu yapıları hatasız verir.
options: A) When people first referred to food as opposed to drink they used the word meat, and it was not until the 1300s that they began to use it for animal flesh.
B) The first use of the word meat by people simply meant food, which was the opposite of drink, and it was only in the 1300s when it started referring to animal flesh.
C) Until the 1300s, the word meat simply meant food for people, as opposed to drink, and only then it started to refer to animal flesh.
D) When people first used the word meat, they simply meant food, as opposed to drink, and it was not until the 1300s that it began to refer to animal flesh.
E) When people first used the word meat, it basically meant food, the opposite of drink, and it hardly started to refer to animal flesh in the 1300s.

questions.questionText: 41. Çok fazla tuz tüketmek kalp damar hastalıklarını tetikler, ancak çok az tuzun da eşit derecede zararlı etkisi olabilir, bu yüzden yüksek tansiyonu olan kişilerin tuz alımlarını azaltması gerekirken, nüfusun geri kalanının tuzu azaltmaya teşvik edilmesine gerek yoktur.
questions.explanation: Türkçe cümlede iki ana kısım vardır: 'Çok fazla tuz... tetikler, ancak... zararlı etkisi olabilir' (Consumption of too much salt leads to..., but too little salt may have an equally harmful effect as well) ve 'bu yüzden... azaltması gerekirken... gerek yoktur' (hence, while people suffering from... need to..., the rest of the population does not need to...). (Not: C şıkkı OCR taramasında eksik çıkmış olsa da, doğru çeviri mantığı budur).
options: A) Consumption of too much salt leads to cardiovascular disease, but too little salt may have an equally harmful effect as well; hence, people suffering from high blood pressure must be encouraged to reduce their salt intake, but the rest of the population need not to cut back on salt.

B) Too much salt consumption triggers cardiovascular diseases, but consuming too little salt can have an equally harmful effect; therefore, individuals with high blood pressure should reduce their salt intake, and the rest of the population should not be encouraged to cut back on salt.

C) Consumption of too much salt leads to cardiovascular disease, but too little salt may have an equally harmful effect as well; hence, while people suffering from high blood pressure need to reduce their salt intake, the rest of the population does not need to be encouraged to cut back on salt.

D) Consuming too much salt causes cardiovascular disease, yet too little salt may also have a similarly harmful effect; thus, people with high blood pressure are required to lower their salt intake, whereas the rest of the population does not have to be encouraged to do so.

E) Excessive salt consumption triggers cardiovascular diseases, but too little salt may have an equally harmful effect; therefore, while those with high blood pressure are asked to lower their salt intake, there is no need to encourage the rest of the population to cut back on salt.

questions.questionText: 42. Her davranış hakkında düşünmek ya da her kararı ölçüp biçmek zorunda olsaydık, hareket edemezdik; bu yüzden insan zihni hayatı daha baş edilebilir hâle getiren zihinsel kestirme yollar ile donatılmıştır.
questions.explanation: Koşul cümlesi '...zorunda olsaydık' (If we had to think about... or weigh up...), sonuç cümlesi '...hareket edemezdik' (...we would be paralysed). İkinci kısım ise 'bu yüzden' (therefore) ile bağlanır.
options: A) If we were to think about every action or weigh up every decision, we would be paralysed, so thanks to the human brain which has been endowed with mental shortcuts, life is more manageable.
B) Should we have to think about every action or weigh up every decision we make, we will be paralysed, but the human brain has been endowed with mental shortcuts that make life easier to be managed.
C) If the human brain were not endowed with mental shortcuts that make life more manageable, we would be paralysed as we would have to think about every action or weigh up every decision.
D) We do not have to think about every action or weigh up every decision, which would make us paralysed, as the human brain has been endowed with mental shortcuts that make life easily managed.
E) If we had to think about every action or weigh up every decision, we would be paralysed; therefore, the human brain has been endowed with mental shortcuts that make life more manageable.

questions.questionText: 43. It is understood from the passage that pigeons ----.
questions.explanation: Parçada güvercinlerin 2 haftalık eğitimin ardından kanserli dokuyu %85 oranında doğru tanımlayabildikleri ('were able to correctly identify cancerous tissue 85 per cent of the time') ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) were able to identify cancerous tissue on mammograms even before the training
B) were motivated by food in the research as they were accepted as bird-brained
C) were fed with food which resembled the tissue on mammograms
D) reached a high percentage of accuracy in identifying cancerous tissue after being trained
E) were better than human radiologists in identifying cancerous tissue

questions.questionText: 44. According to Edward Wasserman, ----.
questions.explanation: Edward Wasserman, güvercinlerin insan yüzlerindeki ifadeleri, harfleri ve hatta 'şekli bozuk farmasötik kapsülleri' ('misshapen pharmaceutical capsules') bile ayırt edebildiklerini söylemektedir.
options: A) pigeons can pick out the pharmaceutical capsules which have differences in shape
B) pigeons are unable to remember images when there are over 1,800 of them
C) letters help pigeons identify the difference between Monet and Picasso paintings
D) pigeons are quite good at imitating emotional expressions displayed on human faces
E) the capacity of pigeons' visual memory is equal to human visual memory

questions.questionText: 45. It is clearly stated in the passage that the interpretation of mammograms ----.
questions.explanation: Parçada doktorların (hekimlerin) mamogramları yorumlamasının 'zaman alıcı, yoğun emek gerektiren ve pahalı' ('time-consuming, labour-intensive and expensive') olduğu açıkça belirtilmiştir.
options: A) provides unreliable feedback about the variables involved
B) considers visual memory as the most critical aspect of interpreting images
C) comes at a high cost both physically and financially
D) requires a more extended training programme to improve validity
E) now commonly uses pigeons to assist with the results

questions.questionText: 46. It can be inferred from the passage that pigeons ----.
questions.explanation: Güvercinlerin tıbbi teşhislerde doğru yorumlamalara ulaşmak için 'araştırmacılara ve mühendislere yardımcı olabilecekleri' ('can assist researchers and engineers') parçanın sonunda ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) can be regarded as the most intelligent bird species considering their success rate
B) can accurately spot cancer on medical images, so they are trained for many years
C) could be used in diagnosis of some diseases in the future to reach correct interpretations
D) should be trained using food for motivation to achieve a high accuracy level in tests
E) will definitely play a significant part in the future training of physicians and radiologists

questions.questionText: 47. The author clearly states that hand-eye coordination ----
questions.explanation: Metinde 4 yaşındaki çocukların ('four-year-old is learning to handle eating cutlery well') çatal-bıçak (eating equipment) kullanımında beceri kazandığı ve el-göz koordinasyonlarının belirgin (apparent) olduğu anlatılmaktadır.
options: A) reaches its final level well before the child reaches the age of six
B) can hardly be seen in kids that are in the pre-school period
C) is ultimately achieved when the child becomes younger than five
D) is apparent in four-year olds as they handle eating equipment well
E) is said to have been completed when the child does a puzzle very fast

questions.questionText: 48. In which of the following does the age or period correctly match the corresponding skill?
questions.explanation: Parçada 'four-year-old is learning to handle eating cutlery well' (4 yaşındakiler çatal-bıçak tutmayı iyi öğreniyor) denmiştir ki bu, 'kaşık kullanarak bağımsız yemek yiyebilmelerine' (possible use of a spoon to eat independently) denktir.
options: A) Pre-school children - almost no autonomy in caring oneself
B) Four-year olds - possible use of a spoon to eat independently
C) Five-year olds - low to moderate competency in hand-eye coordination
D) Six year olds - discernible pause in the improvement in visual orientation
E) Children beyond six years of age lack of preciseness in hand-eye coordination

questions.questionText: 49. According to the passage, tying shoelaces signifies ----.
questions.explanation: Kendi ayakkabı bağcıklarını bağlamanın bu aşamada el-göz koordinasyonunu öğrenmede 'önemli bir kilometre taşı' ('An important milestone...') olduğu metinde belirtilmiştir.
options: A) It shows that the child has obtained total independence in self-care.
B) It is a major breakthrough in the process of acquiring hand-eye coordination.
C) It is the ultimate achievement that the child can reach in terms of hand-eye coordination.
D) By doing it, the child is able to demonstrate a clear change in his/her visual orientation.
E) It represents the high speed at which pre-school children could do some manual tasks.

questions.questionText: 50. Which of the following is the passage mainly concerned with?
questions.explanation: Paragraf temel olarak çocuklarda yaşa göre el-göz koordinasyonunun nasıl geliştiğini ve hangi aşamalardan (phases of development) geçtiğini incelemektedir.
options: A) Phases of development in the acquisition of hand-eye coordination as a key skill
B) Differences and similarities between motor development of pre-school and school-age children
C) What kind of challenges different developmental periods in childhood lead to
D) How pre-school children use their hands and fingers to fulfil certain tasks
E) Hand-eye coordination as one of the easily acquired skills for school-age children

questions.questionText: 51. Which of the following is true about dreams?
questions.explanation: Rüyaların tat, koku, duyma veya acı hislerini içerebileceği ('may include sensations of taste, smell, hearing, or pain') ifade ediliyor. Bu da bazı duyusal (sensory) tecrübeler yaşamanın mümkün olduğunu gösterir.
options: A) Dreams rarely express everyday activities in a deformed manner.
B) Dreamers are the participants in their dreams most of the time.
C) Dreams comply with the general rules of physics unless they counter moral values.
D) Fears and disappointments may be excluded from dreams.
E) It is possible for dreamers to have some sensory experience while dreaming

questions.questionText: 52. According to the passage, 'lucid dreaming' ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde lucid dreaming, 'uyuyan kişinin rüya görürken gerçekten rüya gördüğünün farkında olduğu' ('the sleeper is actually aware of dreaming') bir rüya türü olarak tanımlanmıştır.
options: A) is a type of dream in which dreamers recognise that they are dreaming
B) is apparently the most common type of dream that people have
C) happens when the dreamers are fully awake
D) reveals our daily fears and desires through redundant information.
E) is not related to daytime activities

questions.questionText: 53. Which of the following describes the scientific world's perspective of dreams?
questions.explanation: Bazı bilim insanlarının rüyaların bilinçdışı düşünceleri yansıttığını savunduğu ('maintain that dreams contain...'), diğerlerinin ise önemsiz bir yan ürün ('simple and unimportant by-product') olarak gördüğü belirtilmektedir. Bu da bilim dünyasında bir konsensüs olmadığını (far from reaching a prevailing consensus) gösterir.
options: A) Scientists claim that dreams are important in exploring human psychology.
B) Some scientists devalue dreams because people are unable to recollect what they have in their dreams.
C) Scientists are far from reaching a prevailing consensus over the value of dreams in human life.
D) More scientists than analysts consider dreams as something that can be used to understand people.
E) A good majority of scientists consider dreams as a means for freeing our minds from undesirable content.

questions.questionText: 54. Which could be the best title for the passage?
questions.explanation: Metin genel olarak rüyaların fizik kurallarına meydan okumasını, bilinçle bağlantısını, farklı rüya türlerini (lucid dreaming) ve bilim camiasındaki farklı teorileri açıklayarak rüyaların 'akıl almaz (incomprehensible) dünyası'na ışık tutmaktadır.
options: A) The Incomprehensible World of Dreams
B) The Use of Dreams in Psychoanalysis
C) Common Forms of Dreams
D) The Effects of Dreaming in Daily Life
E) Intellectual Benefits of Having Dreams

questions.questionText: 55. Which of the following is one main feature of dairy processing equipment?
questions.explanation: Metinde ekipmanların süt veya süt ürünlerini kirden, yağdan vb. yabancı maddelerden kontamine (kirlenme) olmasını önlemek için ('designed to prevent contamination...') tasarlandığı belirtilmiştir.
options: A) Protecting dairy products from impurities
B) Preventing detergent solutions from changing the flavour of the products
C) Avoiding prolonged contact of the equipment with chlorine
D) Easing the maintanence of the equipment
E) Focusing on the production rather than the hygiene of the products

questions.questionText: 56. According to the passage, the most commonly used material in dairy processing equipment ----.
questions.explanation: Yaygın olarak kullanılan paslanmaz çeliğin krom ve çelik alaşımı ('an alloy of chromium and steel') olduğu yani iki farklı metalin karışımı olduğu ifade ediliyor.
options: A) can help manufacturers of dairy foods produce tastier products
B) is corrosion-proof, even in cases of prolonged contact with corrosive agents
C) is a mixture of two different metals to increase durability
D) would still be highly resistant to corrosion if the oxide layer were removed
E) includes a protective layer that gets hardened when in contact with chlorine

questions.questionText: 57. Why is dairy processing equipment designed with smooth surfaces?
questions.explanation: Gıda temas yüzeylerinde ürün birikimini (build-up) önlemek için düz yüzeyler sağlamak üzere ('to provide smooth surfaces to avoid build-up of the product') özel olarak tasarlandığı belirtilmektedir.
options: A) To make sure that the equipment is in contact with chlorine
B) To speed up the processing of milk and to produce higher quality dairy products
C) To facilitate the process of disassembling the equipment for further cleaning
D) To prevent the accumulation of dairy products on the surface of the equipment
E) To improve safety and to enable manufacturers to clean the equipment without removing the parts

questions.questionText: 58. Which could be the best title for the passage?
questions.explanation: Paragraf başından sonuna kadar süt üretim/işleme tesislerinde kullanılan ekipmanların tasarımları, hangi maddelerden yapıldıkları (paslanmaz çelik) ve temizlenme kolaylıkları gibi temel özelliklerini anlatmaktadır.
options: A) How to Promote Manufactured Dairy Products
B) Cleanliness as the Main Criteria for Milking
C) Mass Production of Milk and Dairy Products
D) Common Causes of Contamination in Dairy Products
E) Main Features of the Equipment for Dairy Production

questions.questionText: 59. Which of the following is true of the genetic testing of the old bone mentioned in the passage?
questions.explanation: 90.000 yıllık kemikte yapılan yeni DNA testi sayesinde araştırmacıların uzun süredir şüphelendiği melezlenme ('something reseachers had long suspected') teorisinin doğrulandığı anlatılmıştır.
options: A) This is the first time DNA testing was performed on an old bone to identify interbreeding.
B) This is the oldest bone on which mitochondrial testing has been done.
C) Previous genetic testing on it was done at the Max Planck Institute.
D) The findings of the recent research on it have confirmed a long-standing theory.
E) The research done at the Max Planck Institute was the first one to involve paleogeneticists in a study to prove interbreeding.

questions.questionText: 60. It can be understood from the passage that DNA analysis of old bones ----
questions.explanation: Parçadan, sadece kısmi bir teste (mitokondriyal) dayanmaktansa, tüm genom diziliminin yapılıp (examined her entire genome) diğer antik insanlarla karşılaştırılmasının, farklı gruplar arasında melezlenme (interbreeding) oranını veya özelliklerini tespit etmede ne kadar kesin ('unambiguous') sonuç verdiği anlaşılmaktadır. Soru seçeneklerinin OCR kalitesi düşük olduğu için anlamca en yakın şık işaretlenmiştir.
options: A) provides a valuable insight only if the findings are compared to other sequenced genomes
B) gives limited clues about the relationship between the DNA of the parents
C) More research is needed to conclusively identify the extent of early interbreeding.
D) Irregularities in genetic purity in different ethnic groups started in Neanderthal times.
E) Researchers do not need to compare the entire genome to identify the extent of interbreeding.

questions.questionText: 61. The initial attitude of Slon's colleagues towards her findings can be best described as ----.
questions.explanation: Bulgular elde edildiğinde önce kendisinin hata yaptığını ('I had made a mistake') düşünmesi ve sonuçları meslektaşlarına kabul ettirmek için ('convinced myself and my colleagues') deneyleri defalarca tekrar etmesi, meslektaşlarının başlangıçta 'şüpheci' (sceptical) olduklarını gösterir.
options: A) appreciative
B) indifferent
C) sceptical
D) envious
E) tolerant

questions.questionText: 62. Which of the following conclusions can be drawn based on the results indicated in the passage?
questions.explanation: Bir Neandertal anne ve Denisovalı babanın doğrudan yavrularının bulunması ('direct offspring of a Neanderthal and a Denisovan'), farklı erken insan gruplarının bir araya geldiğinde melezlendiklerini ('encountering each other') göstermektedir.
options: A) Interbreeding among different ethnic groups is not a modern concept.
B) It was previously inconceivable that early humans could interbreed.
C) The interaction between Neanderthals and Denisovans was very hostile.
D) Paleogeneticists usually study ancient modern humans' bones.
E) The interbreeding between Denisovans and Neanderthals caused their extinction.

questions.questionText: 63. Daisy: Thank you for your presentation about the differences between the flu and cold, but I missed the part about how their symptoms differ. Presenter: Well, when you have a cold, the symptoms show up primarily above your neck, but if it is the flu, you have the symptoms both above and below your neck. Daisy: ---- Presenter: Yes! When you have a cold, things get worse slowly, but the flu hits you like a high-speed train.
questions.explanation: Daisy'nin hız/şiddet ile ilgili bir şey sorması gerekir ki sunucu 'Evet! Soğuk algınlığında yavaş yavaş kötüleşir, grip ise sana hızla çarpar' yanıtını versin. B şıkkında 'şiddetleri/hiddetleri hakkında da bazı gerçeklerden bahsetmiştiniz' ('facts about their severity') diyerek bu konuyu açar.
options: A) I see. Then, the best thing to do is to rest up when you have a cold.
B) Alright, and you also mentioned some facts about their severity.
C) So, we can say that the flu and cold have similar impacts.
D) I believe you also said that when we have the flu, we have a terrible headache.
E) It's not hard to imagine why so many people confuse cold and the flu.

questions.questionText: 64. Adam: So anyway, I heard that the registration deadline for summer school is fast approaching. You'd better hurry up and register if you want to take that physics class you've been going on and on about. Lara: ---- Adam: Wow, that sounds like a fantastic holiday, something I can only dream of.
questions.explanation: Adam, yaz okulundan sonra gidilecek tatili duyup heyecanla 'Vay canına, harika bir tatil gibi geliyor' diyor. Bu yüzden Lara, yaz okulundan sonra harika bir tatil ('trip to China') planladığını söylemelidir.
options: A) Thanks for keeping me on track, but I wish I could go on holiday instead of going to summer school.
B) Yeah, I will. Speaking of summer, did I tell you that after summer school I've got a trip to China booked? I'm finally going to climb The Great Wall.
C) Sure thing. I'm ready to get this physics class out of the way. By the way, did I mention my summer holiday plans?
D) I need to do that soon since I've wanted to take this class for ages. So I will have some time to go on a trip.
E) I'm sure it's on my to-do list but there are always so many things keeping me busy that I feel it's high time for a bit of rest and relaxation.

questions.questionText: 65. Rob: How lucky that they've found over 80 fossilised dinosaur footprints that have survived for over 100 million years in England! Sherry: ---- Rob: Well, the animal has to step in a sediment that is pliable enough to record their footprint, but not so pliable that it gets washed away before being protected by another layer of fresh sediment. Sherry: Is that so? Seems like a lot of luck is involved then.
questions.explanation: Rob 'Ne şans ama' dediğinde Sherry bir şey soruyor ve Rob hayvanın uygun esneklikteki bir tortuya basması gerektiğini (şartları) açıklıyor. O zaman Sherry'nin 'Fosilleşmeyle şansın ne alakası var?' (What's luck got to do with fossilisation?) demesi gerekir.
options: A) Yes, that's an incredibly rare find!
B) What's luck got to do with fossilisation?
C) What's the significance of these footprints though?
D) Wow! I wish I were lucky enough to discover them.
E) I didn't know England had the exact climate conditions required for fossilisation.

questions.questionText: 66. Kim: Hey! Look at what I've just read. Did you know that the game darts evolved in the 20th century from military training? Hailey: Well, I don't think that's correct. Darts were in use as much about... Archers used these in close combat. Kim: ---- Hailey: Oh, now I know where that interest comes from.
questions.explanation: Hailey okçuların tarihiyle ilgili detayları verdiğinde Kim bunun üzerine kendisinin Anne Boleyn ile ilgili (tarihi) bir kitap okuduğunu, bu bilginin oradan geldiğini söylüyor. Hailey de 'Şimdi o ilginin nereden geldiğini anlıyorum' diyor.
options: A) Everyone in England knows how darts became a big pub sport about a hundred years ago.
B) I was reading a book about Anne Boleyn which has a long part explaining the origins of darts.
C) The traditional setting of darts are pubs and bars and this has created several misconceptions about it, concealing its origins in military training.
D) You need to read more history so you can know how almost everything we modern people do already existed in this or that form thousands of years ago.
E) The National Darts Association is planning to start a campaign to educate the public about darts.

questions.questionText: 67. Mr. Jackson: The price of the innocent mistakes allowed by our current software-based security is simply too high. Mrs. Swanson: ---- Mr. Jackson: Exactly. That's why our networked world needs better approaches to cybersecurity. Mrs. Swanson: Yeah. Just patching the software after a cyberattack, and hoping for the best is not good enough.
questions.explanation: Mr. Jackson güvenlik açığının bedelinin çok yüksek olduğunu söyleyince, Mrs. Swanson'ın bu durumu destekleyerek 'Kritik altyapılar birbirine bağlandıkça, istismar edilebilecek daha çok zafiyet yaratıyoruz' ('create more points of vulnerability') demesi mantıklıdır.
options: A) Right. This sort of restructuring is likely to be a sensible solution to our cybersecurity problems.
B) I couldn't agree more. As critical infrastructure becomes more and more interconnected, we create more points of vulnerability that can be exploited.
C) Data fraud and cyberattacks, however, are listed in its top five most likely global risks by the World Economic Forum.
D) To be honest, software programmers who have many effective ways of protecting a networked society are the best way of dealing with this problem.
E) Fortunately, the risk of exposing sensitive personal data has dramatically decreased recently thanks to software innovations.

questions.questionText: 68. Genuine laughter triggers the release of mood-boosting endorphins, which leads to a higher tolerance for pain.
questions.explanation: 'İçten kahkaha atmak ruh halini yükselten endorfin salınımını tetikler ve bu da acıya karşı toleransı artırır' anlamını, 'İnsanlar içten güldüğünde, bedenleri ruh hallerini iyileştiren endorfin salgılar ve acıya daha iyi tahammül edebilirler' diyerek E şıkkı tam verir.
options: A) Mood-enhancing endorphins are released only when people laugh heartily and thus they can tolerate pain better.
B) People can tolerate more pain if their mood is enhanced by endorphins, which cause hearty laughter.
C) If people want to enhance their mood, they should laugh heartily and tolerate pain better, which helps them release endorphins.
D) To be able to laugh heartily by releasing endorphins that enhance their mood, people have to tolerate pain better.
E) When people laugh heartily, their bodies release endorphins that enhance their mood, and they can tolerate pain better.

questions.questionText: 69. Although some aspects of juvenile animal behaviour are precursors to adult animal behaviour, others are vital for the survival of the young animal.
questions.explanation: Yavru hayvan davranışının bazı yönlerinin yetişkin davranışının öncüsü olduğu ('predict adult animal behaviour'), diğerlerinin ise yavru hayvanın hayatta kalması için hayati olduğu ('determine the likelihood of a young animal surviving') yapısı ve aralarındaki 'Although' zıtlığı E seçeneğinde başarıyla kullanılmıştır.
options: A) Because certain features of juvenile animal behaviour are essential to the survival of the young animal, adult animal behaviour is presupposed by others.
B) Though some sides of juvenile animal behaviour are crucial to the survival of a young animal, other aspects predetermine adult animal behaviour.
C) Even though some characteristics of juvenile animal behaviour give an example of adult animal behaviour, others are vital to the young animals that survive.
D) While a few aspects of juvenile animal behaviour give us a preview of adult animal behaviour, others show us which young animals will survive.
E) Although certain features of juvenile animal behaviour predict adult animal behaviour, others determine the likelihood of a young animal surviving.

questions.questionText: 70. According to a study, 74% of photos we snap on our mobile phones are never looked at again, with selfies being the most easily forgotten shots.
questions.explanation: Cep telefonuyla çekilen fotoğrafların %74'üne bir daha hiç bakılmadığı ('are not viewed again') ve bunların arasında selfielerin en kolay unutulanlar olduğu ('which are the shots that we forget the most easily') E seçeneğinde tam olarak yeniden ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) Research suggests that it is easy to forget that we have taken a selfie and 74% of such photos are taken with our mobile phones.
B) A study suggests that 74% of photos we take using our mobile phones consist of selfies that are not viewed again, which makes us forget them easily.
C) It was revealed by a research study that we easily forget to take a look again at 74% of photos we take with our mobile phones and selfies are some of them.
D) A study finding pointed out that selfies are among 74% of photos we take which we easily forget to look at again on our mobile phones.
E) A study revealed that 74% of photos taken with our mobile phones are not viewed again, including selfies, which are the shots that we forget the most easily.

questions.questionText: 71. Although there are no known side effects associated with recommended dosages of saffron preparations in healthy individuals, people with chronic medical conditions should consult with their healthcare professional before taking the herb.
questions.explanation: Sağlıklı bireylerde safranın önerilen dozlarında yan etki bulunmamasına 'rağmen' ('despite there being no side effects in healthy people...'), kronik tıbbi rahatsızlığı olanların almadan önce doktora danışması gerektiği ('It is advisable for individuals with chronic medical conditions to see their healthcare specialist...') en iyi B şıkkında verilmiştir.
options: A) If saffron preparations are consumed in sufficient amounts by healthy individuals and provide only benefits, then, it goes without saying that patients with chronic medical conditions can safely take them after consulting their healthcare specialist.

B) It is advisable for individuals with chronic medical conditions to see their healthcare specialist prior to taking saffron treatments despite there being no side effects in healthy people when taking the herb in suggested amounts.

C) While little is known about the dangers for healthy individuals taking saffron preparations, it is certain that people with chronic medical conditions should approach their healthcare before consuming the herb.
D) Since healthy individuals can freely take saffron preparations, patients with chronic medical illnesses can, after seeing their healthcare professional, take the herb in recommended dosages.

E) Regardless of how much saffron an individual with a chronic medical condition can take after consulting their healthcare specialist, a healthy person has to take only the recommended amounts of the herb to avoid any side effects.

questions.questionText: 72. The decline of England's wild bees has been linked for the first time to the use of neonicotinoid pesticides on oilseed rape farms. ---- But recently, Ben Woodcock at the Centre for Ecology and Hydrology in Wallingford, UK, and his colleagues have studied data on 62 bee species from 31,800 surveys across more than 4,000 square kilometres of land.
questions.explanation: İlk cümlede yaban arısı ölümleriyle tarım ilacı arasında bir bağlantıdan bahsediliyor. 'Ama son zamanlarda' diye devam ettiği için; öncesinde 'önceden de etkileri belgelenmişti fakat özellikle bu pestisitlere odaklanan güçlü bir kanıt yoktu' cümlesinin getirilmesi geçmiş ve günümüz zıtlığını pekiştirir.
options: A) Researchers have concluded that many other factors affect bee-to-bee communication, such as climate change and disease.
B) These pesticides do not only contribute to the decline in the number of wild bee species, but they also hurt their ability to reproduce.
C) The effects such pesticides have on bees have been documented before, but there was no strong evidence focusing particularly on neonicotinoid pesticides.
D) Studies done on wild bees that eat plants with neonicotinoid pesticides have not yielded reliable results, so researchers now look for different reasons for bee decline.
E) In February 2018, the European Union approved the ban on neonicotinoid pesticides in an effort to protect bees and other valuable pollinator insects.

questions.questionText: 73. Thousands of individual parts make up the modern automobile. Much like the human body, these parts are arranged into several semi-independent systems, each with a different function. ---- The automobile contains similar circulatory systems to cool the engine using fluid (mostly water) and to circulate oil and fuel within the system.
questions.explanation: Otomobilin parçaları insan vücuduna (human body) benzetiliyor. Sonrasında otomobillerin dolaşım sistemlerinden (circulatory systems) bahsediyor. Bu nedenle boşlukta 'Örneğin insan vücudundaki dolaşım sistemi kalp, damarlar vb.'nden oluşur' cümlesi otomobille analojiyi sağlamak için gereklidir.
options: A) For example, our circulatory system comprises the heart, blood vessels, and blood.
B) The major systems of an automobile include the engine, fuel system, transmission, and electrical system.
C) When an automobile is designed, the arrangement and type of components depend on various factors.
D) Furthermore, the dependence on petroleum fuel of automobiles leads to power struggles and thus influences global politics.
E) Automobiles have given great freedom of movement to their owners.

questions.questionText: 74. As elephants walk through the forest or savanna, they leave big footprints behind them. These marks then fill with water, creating microhabitats for other forms of life. Researchers at Germany's University of Koblenz-Landau analysed the contents of 30 footprints in Uganda. They found at least 61 different micro-invertebrate species, including mites. ---- Nevertheless, the study adds to a body of research suggesting that elephants play vital roles in their ecosystems.
questions.explanation: Araştırmacılar 61 farklı tür buluyor. Sonraki cümlede 'Yine de (Nevertheless) fillerin önemli rol oynadığını kanıtlıyor' diyor. Boşluğa, çalışmanın yeni bir alanda (early stage) olduğunu ve küçük türlerin ayak izlerine ne kadar dayandığını anlamak için daha fazlasının yapılması gerektiğini vurgulayan D şıkkı getirilmelidir.
options: A) Researchers also think that this study serves as one more reminder of what we could lose if the illegal hunting crisis in Africa continues.
B) Because elephants weigh upward of 6,000 kilograms, they make quite an impression with their giant footprints.
C) Thanks to this study, researchers have proven without doubt that elephant footprints teem with life.
D) This work is in its early stage and more needs to be done to understand how heavily the tiny species rely on these footprint worlds.
E) The most common species found in these footprints were mayflies, backswimmers, leeches and gastropods.

questions.questionText: 75. Cities are dense with impermeable sidewalks and streets, so the concrete jungle does not exactly absorb excess water during storms. The result: destructive flash floods. To help, a Danish architectural firm has developed a tile-based modular paving system that collects and distributes rainwater. ---- The system captures water from roofs, streets, and parking lots, and delivers it to nearby permeable landscapes such as garden boxes or park spaces - where it can be absorbed.
questions.explanation: Danimarkalı bir mimarlık firmasının geliştirdiği modüler fayans tabanlı döşeme sisteminden söz edildikten sonra, bu sistemin (fayansların) 'nasıl çalıştığını' (üzerindeki küçük deliklerin suyu kanallara aktardığını) anlatan C seçeneği gelmelidir.
options: A) Since permable pavements come in different forms, urban planners in other countries prefer to use a type of porous asphalt to absorb storm run-off.
B) Plants could be considered a necessity since they offer many perks to cities providing shade, beauty, and habitat for wildlife.
C) These tiles resemble a normal paved surface but have small holes in them that funnel storm run-off into horizontally connected channels.
D) Roads, sidewalks, and terraces connect people but are often also impermeable to rain or flood waters.
E) One concern environmentalists have is preventing fertile storm run-off from mixing with everyday pollutants like sewage.

questions.questionText: 76. (I) Radar and its laser counterpart lidar can detect out-of-sight objects. (II) But haze, rain, smoke and dust throw these tools off by scattering light and radio waves. (III) By using statistical analysis and modeling, researchers reconstruct objects in 3-D. (IV) Now optics researchers at the University of Central Florida have taken advantage of this property to track a moving object hidden by a simulated fog. (V) By analysing subtle changes that an object creates in a pattern of scattered light, the researchers can instantly obtain the object's direction and speed.
questions.explanation: I, II, IV ve V numaralı cümleler radar ve lidar gibi araçların ışığı/dalgaları dağıtan engelleri (sis, yağmur, duman) kullanarak hareket eden nesneleri nasıl izlediklerini anlatır. Ancak III. cümlede araştırmacıların istatistiksel analizle 3 boyutlu nesne rekonstrüksiyonu yapması konu dışıdır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 77. (I) Current research indicates that there has been an increase in references to health and weight loss in food advertisements. (II) Food advertisers use a range of well-known figures who enjoy widespread recognition to act as spokespeople for a product and recommend it to the public. (III) Especially after 1920, advertisers were aware of the relationship between popular culture idols and their audiences. (IV) Such important early figures included movie stars and popular entertainers. (V) The list was later extended to include television stars and individuals from occupations such as politics, sports, the arts, business.
questions.explanation: Paragraf II, III, IV ve V. cümlelerinde yiyecek reklamcılarının meşhur figürleri sözcü olarak kullanmalarını ve bu eğilimin 1920'lerden bu yana nasıl genişlediğini anlatmaktadır. I. cümlede reklamlar aracılığıyla sağlık ve kilo vermeye yapılan atıflardan bahsedilmesi ise konu bütünlüğünü bozar.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 78. (I) Some people believe that we are a long way away from robots or instruments with artificial intelligence replicating our human intelligence processes and expanding beyond them without human support. (II) A few years before his death, Stephen Hawking, the noted cosmologist and science populariser, warned that artificial intelligence, fully developed, "could spell the end of the human race." (III) Elon Musk, a private investor in space travel, has issued similar warnings lately. (IV) What both men were concerned about when they expressed their ideas is the military applications of artificial intelligence. (V) Although, so far, there are not high levels of military spending to further advance artificial intelligence, it might be assumed that the actual spending could be obscured due to security concerns.
questions.explanation: Paragraf (II) numaralı cümle ile Stephen Hawking'in yapay zekanın tehlikeleri konusundaki uyarısıyla başlar, Musk'ın uyarılarıyla devam eder ve askeri uygulamalar/harcamalar üzerinden ilerler. I. cümledeki 'insanların yapay zekanın gelişmesini hala çok uzak görmesi' fikri paragrafın asıl teması olan potansiyel tehlike ve uyarılar odağını bozmaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 79. (I) Nobody knows exactly where music came from because there are no written records. (II) A good guess would be that thousands of years ago, primitive peoples used music in much the same way as we use it now: to communicate, to pass time while working, to express joy or sadness, or to mark a special occasion. (III) Flutes were among the earliest instruments to be found in all parts of the world. (IV) The first instrument was the one every person is born with-the body. (V) We have voices to sing and shout with, hands to clap, and feet to stamp and this is enough to create melody and rhythm.
questions.explanation: Paragraf müziğin kökeni ve ilkel insanların müziği nasıl/neden kullandıkları (I, II) ve bu müziğin enstrümanı olarak insan vücudunun kullanılması (IV, V) üzerinde durmaktadır. III. cümle, flütün bulunan en eski enstrümanlardan biri olduğunu belirterek konudan sapmaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 80. (I) The naming of constellations dates back to ancient civilisations. (II) In 140 AD the ancient Greek astronomer Claudius Ptolemy catalogued and named 48 constellations visible from Alexandria, Egypt. (III) All but one of those 48, Argo Navis (Argonauts' Ship), which was subdivided in the 1750s into four separate constellations, are still included in present-day star catalogues. (IV) Stars, nebulae, or galaxies in the same constellation may or may not have anything in common. (V) Many new constellations were named in later centuries, mostly in previously uncharted parts of the sky in the Southern Hemisphere and those with originally Greek names were later changed with Latin equivalents by which they are still known today.
questions.explanation: I, II, III ve V numaralı cümleler takımyıldızların isimlendirilmesinin ve kataloglanmasının antik dönemlerden modern zamanlara uzanan tarihsel gelişimini ele alırken, IV numaralı cümlede aynı takımyıldızdaki yıldızların/galaksilerin birbirinden bağımsız olduğuna dair verilen bilimsel gerçek konu bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V
